description: Implement a manager-based RL environment for UR10 with suction gripper to pick and place a single box. Binary suction on/off action, randomized pick and place positions, phased dense rewards.

userStories.title: Research existing APIs (SurfaceGripper, UR10 suction asset)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to know the exact API for SurfaceGripper and UR10_LONG_SUCTION_CFG so that I implement observations and actions correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: SurfaceGripper data API identified (gripping state access)
UR10_LONG_SUCTION_CFG prim paths and ee_link name confirmed
Any existing pick-place suction example found
userStories.notes: SurfaceGripper.state returns (-1=open, 0=closing, 1=closed). SurfaceGripperCfg at {ENV_REGEX_NS}/Robot/ee_link/SurfaceGripper. UR10_LONG_SUCTION_CFG uses variant Long_Suction. Existing stack example in stack/config/ur10_gripper/.

userStories.title: Create directory scaffold and base env config
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the directory structure and base env config so that I have the skeleton to fill in.
acceptanceCriteria: SceneCfg, ActionsCfg, ObservationsCfg, RewardsCfg, TerminationsCfg, EventCfg stubs defined
userStories.notes: Base env cfg created. SceneCfg includes box RigidObjectCfg with blue_block.usd. device=cpu set for suction gripper.

userStories.title: Implement MDP modules (observations, rewards, terminations, events)
userStories.description: As a developer, I want custom MDP functions for the pick-and-place task so that the agent can learn the full pick-place behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: observations.py: ee_pos_w, ee_quat_w, box_pos_w, box_quat_w, goal_pos, suction_state implemented
rewards.py: approach_box, grasp, lift_box, place_box, success_bonus implemented
userStories.notes: All MDP modules implemented. Goal pos converted from robot base frame to world frame using robot.data.root_pos_w.

userStories.title: Implement robot-specific config and agent config
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the UR10 Long Suction robot config and RSL-RL PPO agent config so that training can be launched.
acceptanceCriteria: joint_pos_env_cfg.py: UR10LongSuctionPickPlaceEnvCfg defined with robot, surface_gripper, ee_frame, actions
userStories.notes: UR10LongSuctionPickPlaceEnvCfg uses RelativeJointPositionActionCfg + SurfaceGripperBinaryActionCfg. ee_frame OffsetCfg pos=[0.22, 0, 0] for long suction tip.

userStories.title: Gym registration and import wiring
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the gym IDs registered so that training can be launched with the standard train.py script.
userStories.notes: Gym IDs registered. deploy/__init__.py updated with from .pick_place_suction import *.

userStories.title: Smoke test: environment creation and short training run
userStories.description: As a developer, I want to verify the environment runs correctly so that I can confirm the implementation is correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Environment can be instantiated without errors
Action space is 7D, observation space is 30D
Reward values change (not constant) during training
userStories.notes: Requires Isaac Sim runtime - cannot run in CI. User must run the smoke test.
